stalls.summaryZh: 外酥內Q，裹花生粉或芝麻粉，放涼也還脆，常要排隊。
stalls.summaryEn: Crisp outside, chewy inside, rolled in peanut or sesame powder; still crisp when cool, often queued for.

stalls.summaryEn: Over 50 years old; melt-in-mouth pork with popular side dishes.

sources.title: 食尚玩家：高雄夜市27間攻略

stalls.summaryEn: Layered crepe with fillings like tuna or three-cup chicken; long lines, so pre-order.
